findings.passage: The reality and the facts are, when you look at this bill and you get down to the numbers, you get down to the manner in which they're cutting voting time for urban community, they're dismantling drive-through voting - which 60% of drive-through voters were women - dismantling 24-hour voting.
findings.note: NPR interview with Rep. Ann Johnson during the 2021 walkout over the Texas elections bill that became SB 1. She names voting hours and drive-through voting as her concerns and does not mention ID or citizenship proof in this passage.
subjects: early voting hours and drive-through voting
